vecHighlight.strDescription: Craft the final upgrade to the Cell Phone.
Get your villagers fully combat ready.
Find the ultra rare Rod of Discord.
Bring back the original title screen.
Fly a Kwad Racer into outer space.
Meet with a tenant who's as happy as they possibly can be!
Have all possible town NPCs living in your world.
Delay death from drowning by drinking water. It doesn't make much sense, but you did what you had to do.
Obtain the Cell Phone. You'll never leave home without it again.
Complete your 25th quest for the angler.
Complete your 10th quest for the angler.
Invoked the wrath of the God of Torches, and survived long enough to earn its blessing.

vecUnachieved.strDescription: Find all of the Slime Pets and have them move in!
Catalogue every creature in the world.
Prove your worth against the Moon Lord's worst.
Support sustainable logging by planting 100 acorns.
Die as a hardcore character and survive to tell the tale.
Complete your 50th quest for the angler.
Dawn the garb of a vampire and get a sunburn.
“Accidentally” kill a friend with your tombstone.
Give the Dryad a can of Joja Cola.
Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.
